{"reason":"Adding the provided high-confidence condition rejects six of the eight displayed false arbitrations (confidence 0.44–0.67), directly reducing v1’s 0.714 false-arbitration rate. Recall currently has 0.20 headroom above the 0.80 business gate.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
